annotations.title: A state's official unclaimed property search

description: A state's official unclaimed property search. For requests like "do I have unclaimed money in Ohio?", "how do I find money I'm owed in the UK?", "how do I find unclaimed property in Texas?", "I've lived in Ohio, Texas and California, where do I look?". Returns the official state search link (and a direct search_url), MissingMoney.com, tips, a claim checklist and a scam warning. With several states, the first is at the top level and the rest are in more_states.

country.description: Two-letter country code. GB (or UK) gives the UK tracing services. Defaults to the caller's country, else US.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, DC or Puerto Rico, or UK (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, London). Several can be listed with commas or "and" (up to 8). Big city names like NYC also work. Up to 200 characters. Required unless country=GB.
